name: Long Fang of the Moon
author: voodoo573
description:
Legendary magic weapon (requires attunement) from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this silvered longsword.

Weapon attacks using long fang of the moon deal an extra 2d6 radiant damage against creatures. When you hit a shapeshifter with this weapon, it makes a DC 30 Constitution saving throw or reverts to its original form. If it fails this saving throw, you may choose to prevent the shapeshifter from transforming for up to 10 minutes.

Hearth applies the +3 and the extra 2d6 radiant on every hit. The shapeshifter save is tracked by hand.
summary: Legendary +3 silvered longsword dealing 2d6 extra radiant; forces shapeshifters back to true form.
